metadata.description: Role-based skill bundles for targeted installation. Each bundle groups skills by professional role or workflow.

bundles.name: Core Developer
bundles.description: Essential skills for any software developer: planning, testing, debugging, and code quality.

bundles.name: Frontend Engineer
bundles.description: Skills for frontend and full-stack developers working with React, Next.js, and browser testing.

bundles.name: Backend Engineer
bundles.description: Skills for backend developers building APIs, databases, and server-side systems.

bundles.name: AI Engineer
bundles.description: Skills for developers building AI agents, RAG pipelines, and LLM-powered applications.

bundles.name: Software Architect
bundles.description: Skills for system design, architecture decisions, and large-scale patterns.

bundles.name: DevOps Engineer
bundles.description: Skills for CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure, and observability.

bundles.name: Security Specialist
bundles.description: Skills for application security, authentication, and compliance auditing.

bundles.name: Compliance Auditor
bundles.description: Full compliance and governance skill set for regulated industries.

bundles.name: QA Engineer
bundles.description: Comprehensive testing skills from unit tests through E2E and mutation testing.

bundles.name: Tech Lead
bundles.description: Skills for technical leadership: architecture, code review, documentation, and team workflows.
